attributes.during: After building location decks, display the villain Ghlorofaex next to this card. While displayed, when you defeat a henchman, put it under Ghlorofaex, and when you attempt to close a location, Ghlorofaex uses his power.When the number of henchmen under Ghlorofaex is at least equal to the number of characters, the next time you encounter a henchman, banish that henchman, add Ghlorofaex to the location deck, and encounter him. To win the scenario, defeat and corner Ghlorofaex.
